title: US CTO Ethan Klein plans to urge the UK and its allies to help "shore up" quantum computing supply chains at a London meeting, after a US-UK tech deal standoff (Joe Miller/Financial Times)
summary: Joe Miller / Financial Times: US CTO Ethan Klein plans to urge the UK and its allies to help “shore up” quantum computing supply chains at a London meeting, after a US-UK tech deal standoff — US CTO Ethan Klein seeks British co-operation amid stand-off over wider tech pact
